grh_de0d842455786d77b9ef.title: Dead Candidate
paragraphs: Harry tries honest business by taking the Bazzo soft-drink concession in the tiny Mediterranean republic of Malini, only to be pulled into a thoroughly dishonest election. Local political bosses treat him as a supposed Washington connection while opponents are eliminated, promises of democracy are staged for effect, and even the timing of a candidate's death becomes campaign strategy. Quarantined with Malinian measles, Harry watches much of the intrigue from the sidelines as Susie brings news. The whole scheme is finally swept aside when outside power Frieza intervenes and declares Malini liberated, putting Harry on an outbound plane and convincing him never to go straight again.

grh_de786faaedd6f1656d60.title: Can Do
paragraphs: A dramatized adaptation of William Bradford Huie's Can Do surveys the wartime work of the Navy Seabees through a veteran narrator looking back after discharge. The program moves through construction under fire, beach landings, mines, airstrips and the deaths of fellow workers rather than following one continuous plot. It emphasizes the Seabees' mixture of engineering and combat, including a doctor's decision to save a wounded Japanese prisoner, and closes with the narrator describing the Seabees' pride in building whatever the Navy needs wherever the war takes them.
